description: Fixture cases that no SDK driver runs, accepted as a known backlog. check_case_pinning.py --strict fails on any unpinned case; this file records the ones already known so the backlog can shrink without new ones slipping in. A case here is NOT covered — it only looks covered, in the fixture and in every count derived from the inventory. Delete an entry when a driver starts running it; the list reaching empty is the signal to run --strict everywhere.
